clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —Requirements for manufacture, dimensions and tolerances, and marking for injection moulded and machine moulded HDFE  sandwich flanges Note — For general requirements regarding material, manufacture, methods of test, etc,  refer to IS  8008 (Part I ) :2003 Injection moulded high density polyethylene (HDPE) fittings for potable water supplies : Part 1 General requirements, for fittings. For detailed information, refer to IS 8008 (Part 7 ) : 2003 Specification for injection moulded high density polyethylene (HDPE) fittings for portable water supplies : Part 7 Specific requirements for sandwich flanges.
